name: Lyo.QRCode.QRCoder
tagline: QRCoder implementation of `IQRCodeService` from `Lyo.QRCode`. Use this for JPEG / Bitmap on Windows, or QRCoder's renderers.
description: QRCoder implementation of `IQRCodeService` from [`Lyo.QRCode`](../Lyo.QRCode/README.md). Use this when you need JPEG / Bitmap output on Windows or want QRCoder's renderers. Use `BuiltInQRCodeService` when you want the in-library ISO encoder with no extra NuGet.

examples.title: Usage

sections.title: Types
rows: `IQRCodeService` implementation. No image dependencies. Decoration (logo, frame, caption, padding) is the consumer's job via `Lyo.Images.IImageDecorationService`.

sections.title: Notes
items: JPEG / Bitmap outputs go through `System.Drawing` and work on Windows. PNG/SVG paths run cross-platform.
Decoding (`ReadFromImageAsync`) uses `QRCodeZxingRead` in this package (ZXing.Net + ImageSharp), same as the built-in service.

**Decoration is out of scope.** The QRCoder service no longer applies center logos or frames. Pipe the returned bytes through `Lyo.Images.IImageDecorationService.Pipeline(...)` and call `Overlay` / `AddFrame` / `AddCaption` / `AddOuterPadding` as needed (see the [`Lyo.Images` README](../../Images/Lyo.Images/README.md)).
